blocks.title: 1. The Core Concept: The Foundation of Everything
blocks.content: All of mathematics, from simple shopping bills to rocket science, is built on just four operations: **Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (x), and Division (/)**. These are the four pillars. If your arithmetic is fast and accurate, everything else in math becomes easier. If it's shaky, every future topic will feel ten times harder.

blocks.title: 2. The Rules: BODMAS/PEMDAS
blocks.content:
When a problem has multiple operations, you MUST follow the correct order:

• **B**rackets first
• **O**rders (powers and roots)
• **D**ivision and **M**ultiplication (left to right)
• **A**ddition and **S**ubtraction (left to right)

This is called BODMAS (or PEMDAS). Without it, 3 + 2 x 4 could give you 20 (wrong!) instead of 11 (correct!).

blocks.title: 3. Step-by-Step: Working with Negatives
blocks.content:
Negative number rules are critical:

1. **Positive x Positive = Positive** (3 x 4 = 12)
2. **Negative x Negative = Positive** (-3 x -4 = 12)
3. **Positive x Negative = Negative** (3 x -4 = -12)
4. **Subtracting a negative = Adding** (5 - (-3) = 5 + 3 = 8)

Remember: same signs multiply to positive, different signs multiply to negative.

blocks.title: 5. Common Pitfalls
blocks.content: The most catastrophic error: doing operations LEFT TO RIGHT instead of following BODMAS! In 3 + 2 x 4, students add 3+2 first to get 5, then multiply by 4 to get 20. **WRONG!** Multiplication comes before addition in BODMAS. The correct answer is 3 + 8 = 11. Always scan the entire expression for higher-priority operations before you start calculating!
